blurb: Guests experience a hot air balloon ride over the Sonoran Desert, including viewing the balloon inflation, a 45-60 minute flight, a post-flight champagne toast, catered cuisine, and commemorative flight certificates. Rides are available daily year-round in Phoenix and Tucson, with seasonal afternoon rides in Phoenix. The total tour time is 3-3.5 hours from check-in or 4-4.5 hours with roundtrip hotel transportation.

quotes.text: We were very pleased with our experience. The entire operation was handled flawlessly. It was reassuring to feel like you were with true professionals. Tommy our pilot was great. It was definitely a bucket list thing to do but now I am ready to do it again. If you have any reservations put them to rest. It was the most relaxing and peaceful thing. Almost no sensation of movement at all. Not even like going up on an elevator. We were 100 feet above the ground before I even realized it.

This was our first hot air balloon ride and it was amazing, the pilot Tommy was very knowledgeable and nice which made the ride even better. My husband and I are both afraid of heights but we literally felt no motion. I would highly recommend using this company for this experience. It was our wedding anniversary and this was an awesome way to start off our day.

I can’t say enough good things about our balloon ride early this morning. It was a beautiful day made even better by the care and concern shown by our captain and crew. From tending to those with nerves to providing detailed explanations to those who were curious, they really went above and beyond. Well worth the 4 am wake-up call!!

We had the privilege of experiencing a hot air balloon ride when we were in Arizona to celebrate our vow renewal last Fall. An amazing experience to say the least. The crew is very professional and safety conscious. We thoroughly enjoyed it. We thought it would be a one time experience, but we definitely want to do it again.

This was the best! We thoroughly enjoyed the adventure and I would recommend this to anyone that loves the scenic outdoors and the great hospitality of a balloon ride!!!! From start to finish it was awesome!
It was on my bucket list, the experience was wonderful as well as the staff. Thank you to Capt Al for showing us a good time. I have to put this back on my list, it was that good.
